# Remparia

> Remparia deploys supervised business agents for specialized professions. Humans keep the decision. Data stays under control.

Remparia is a French operator partner for regulated and trust-based professions (legal, finance, notarial, accounting, consulting, commerce, real estate). Work follows SIGNAL → Studio → Remparia OS. Every agent action hits ALLOW, REVIEW or BLOCK.

## Agent-readable site view

Append `?view=agent` to any public page URL to switch from the human UI to a Markdown source view (toggle HUMAN | AGENT on the page).

Example: https://www.remparia.com/fr?view=agent

Longer citeable digest: https://www.remparia.com/llms-full.txt

## Glossary

- **SIGNAL**: six-stage method (10–12 weeks) to observe real work, score AI cases and deliver a prioritized opportunity map. Nothing is automated before it has been observed.
- **Studio**: workshop that assembles agents, skills, tools, knowledge and human approvals, ready to run in Remparia OS.
- **Remparia OS**: control plane for agents, models, enterprise data and human decisions (identity, policies, memory, tools, observability, audit).
- **ALLOW / REVIEW / BLOCK**: gates applied before every agent action. ALLOW executes, REVIEW waits for a human, BLOCK stops. Rules live in the OS, not in a PDF.
- **Sovereignty**: hosting perimeter for the same governed OS: Remparia Cloud, sovereign cloud, or on-premise. Same policies after a move.

## What we do not do

- We do not replace professional judgment or accountability.
- We do not deploy unmanaged automation on sensitive data.
- We do not sell generic tools without field integration and governance.
- We do not invent client proof or ROI figures on this site.

## How to start

1. The hour (free): frame the repetitive work, data constraints and outcomes to measure.
2. Diagnostic: ranked process map, sketched governance. Fixed fee, no follow-on obligation.
3. First agent: supervised production in existing tools, documented, under your rules.
